# Command reference

Every page here is generated from the help of the real `varco` command, so the flags cannot drift from the code. Run `make docs` after a flag changes.

## Commands

| Command | Description | Reference |
|---|---|---|
| `varco diff` | compare two endpoints | [diff](diff.md) |
| `varco plan` | derive probe cases from Ingress manifests | [plan](plan.md) |
| `varco run` | execute a probe plan against two endpoints | [run](run.md) |
| `varco version` | print build version | [version](version.md) |
